steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: ...My head hurts.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: There you are, big guy. Here, ice for that bump on your head.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Y-You're the kid who attacked me?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Call me a kid again, and you'll get another bump on the back of your head.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: They found the meds they lost, so the misunderstanding with us has been resolved...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Meds? Misunderstanding? Resolved?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: It wasn't so hard persuading that poor driver to cooperate, after all.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Wha... I'm even more confused now... where are we?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Come, see for yourself.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Here's your medicine. Careful with it.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Th-Thank you...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What's your name? Check it off the list.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Mike... there.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Two portions left.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Let me check the list again. Maybe someone forgot to come... see if anyone hasn't signed.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The last two are mine.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: *cough* I-I'm sorry about today. We didn't know someone else was behind the robbery...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's ok. Glad to see that the medicine ended up in the hands of those who need it.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Gustave told me that a lot of people here are afflicted with a special condition that requires these suppressants to control.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: So... wasn't that Capitán at odds with Reynell? Why is he stealing our meds to suck up to Reynell now?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Miłosz told me that he's after Reynell's development rights in this district.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: And what if he gets it? Reynell had the rights himself, and he couldn't do anything about us.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Good thing too. It would be a shame if the local culture here got replaced by hotels and casinos.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: You've only been here half a day, and you're talking like you know the place well.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And in this half a day, everyone who came for their medicine was trying to promote their artwork to me.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: People have to eat, after all... what's that on your arm?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A braided wristband. I didn't plan on buying it, but then I saw the kid's hands full of needle marks...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Whisper) Who could be so clumsy?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Uhh... I mean... would you like to take a break in my workshop?

steps.name: Auction Host
steps.text: 50 million Columbian gold certificates! 50 million going once, 50 million going twice!

steps.name: Auction Host
steps.text: Sold for 50 million gold certificates!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What did you say? The warehouse that kept losing stuff? Which one?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The one from the pharmaceutical company that shut down six months after you acquired it.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I seem to remember something of the sort... so, some people stole meds meant for that neighborhood, framed you for it, then tried to sneak those meds into that warehouse.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: To be precise, they tried to frame you.

spans.text: To be precise, they tried to frame

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What do you want me to do, then? Thank you for resolving the misunderstanding?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: There's no need for that, Mr. Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miłosz says you're leaving the accommodations I arranged for you. Have you found your friends?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, we just found another place to stay.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: That neighborhood.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: There? Not that I'm against it or anything, but why?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I saw something interesting.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: This is my workshop. There's a lot of space here. I work together with other artists, looking for inspiration, sometimes exhibiting our work.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Are those wet papers abandoned drafts?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No, they're finished artwork.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Finished?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: There's a guy who leaves his paintings outside and lets the rain dissolve the paint. The work isn't finished until that step is done.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The man who's flexing his muscles... is he looking for inspiration?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Strictly speaking, he's a work of art too.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Performance art?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Read the plaque in front of him.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: 'Name: Pepe Turrión. Artist: Pepe Turrión's parents.'

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: 'Description: Six months after creating this work, the artists abandoned it in the suburbs of Dossoles due to lack of economic value.'

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: 'Little could they imagine that Pepe Turrión would become one of the greatest masterpieces of Dossoles twenty years later. Eat shit, jerks.'

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Solemn Man
steps.text: I am the greatest Originium Artist in Dossoles. Would you like to see my Arts?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Is he better than you, Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No one's better, when it comes to Originium Arts.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Be careful and don't hurt our guests.

steps.name: Solemn Man
steps.text: Of course.
The man takes out a few dark crystals from his pocket, each one glowing with an orange-yellow light. The visitors cautiously take a few steps back.
The pure Originium Prime crystals begin to spin in the man's palm. Then, he tosses them into the air one by one.
He begins to juggle pure Originium.
After a few rounds, he tosses all of them into the air at the same time, then looks up and catches the first one with his nose.
Then the next, and the next... finally, all the crystals form a tower on the tip of his nose.
The man turns slightly, and the tower of pure Originium slides back into his palm.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I thought Arts was about flashing lights and fireballs... that's Originium Arts?

steps.name: Solemn Man
steps.text: What is this, if not Originium? What did I demonstrate, if not arts?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I... see...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: My biggest work lies beyond this door.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I think I've said this not too long ago, but I want to say it again—nothing could surprise me now.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Two mannequin heads? So big?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Those are just the heads. You haven't seen the bodies yet.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They'll be dancing the night our arts festival begins.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They will dance when the twin moons begin to set, and the sunlight has yet to shine.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They will be the center of attention, the stars of the show. They will turn and pirouette on the streets, stepping in tune and gracing the entire community.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: A beautiful picture.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm sure many people will be dancing with them.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No, maybe...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You don't know?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Nobody has danced in a long time, ever since that dance hall fire.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I told you, they've got innovative structures, deep emotions, delicate expressions.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Interesting... you've piqued my interest in what those people are doing.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: If you're going to that neighborhood, will you see what they're doing on my behalf?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I thought you weren't happy that they planned their arts festival on the same day as your opening ceremony.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Doesn't mean I can't be interested in what they're doing.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I can observe what they're doing on your behalf, but I have no reason to intervene in your conflict with them.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Of course not! Not that I wouldn't appreciate it if you could convince them to change the date.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I can't make you any promises.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You can't succeed if you don't try.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Anyway, I'm surprised you're willing to learn more about what they're doing.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You wouldn't be surprised if you were willing to learn more about me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Auction Host
steps.text: Collection No. 257, antique music box, starting price 15 million gold certificates. Any bidders?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Shh... I have to focus.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Auction Host
steps.text: 20 million! Anyone else? 20 million!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Auction Host
steps.text: Er... same bidder to 25 million?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: There's no one bidding against you.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I don't care what anyone else bids. I just want to raise it to the price I think it's worth.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I-I apologize for my rash decision...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: But we didn't think they would have the nerve to openly insult Coalition government forces that...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I-I understand! Next time—there won't be a next time!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I'll accept any punishment if this happens again! You can fire me, court-martial me, anything!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Capitán...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Shut up. Now the brass knows about that stupid truck driver.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: They stripped him naked and dropped him at our front door. The brass considers it an open insult to the Coalition government.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: They asked whether our relationship with Reynell can continue, whether there is hope of obtaining the land. What am I supposed to say?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Stupid, incompetent idiots.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Capitán, Reynell's secretary is here... do you want to see him?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Show him in.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: If you're just here to complain on Reynell's behalf, you can save it.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Of course not, Mr. Mateo. Reynell is satisfied with your efficiency. You were just a little... reckless.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: There are many Infected in that community. Stealing their medicine is one way to take them down. But you must understand that, if many Infected die because of it...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Making a big mess does none of us any good.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We understand. What else did he tell you?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: What he means is that, if you were too reckless before, perhaps a more cautious approach now can bring about a peaceful resolution.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We've gotten to this point, and you want me to negotiate with those people?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No, Mr. Mateo. There's no need for you to worry about it. Mr. Reynell has already sent someone to do it.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Miss Ela and her squad.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're familiar with them, no? Your men have had dealings with them, and people have even confused them with your men.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We have an agreement, Miłosz. Don't forget it.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No need to get excited, Mr. Mateo. Reynell doesn't intend to terminate his cooperation with you. He just asks for cooler heads.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: We can talk about the land once you're calm enough to do so.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Is there any message that you would like me to deliver to Mr. Reynell?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I take my leave, then.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You were playing games with me, weren't you, Reynell?!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You're dead, Reynell, DEAD, if I don't get that piece of land from you!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: 150 million? He bid a music box to 150 million on his own?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: He may be eccentric, but he shows respect to what he considers art, in his own way.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It sounds like you're starting to change your mind about him.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I've never made up my mind about him, Meijer. He's not easy to make up your mind about.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Is that what makes him interesting?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'll admit that he's not your traditional, boring art dealer.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That's saying quite a bit, coming from you. You're not big on compliments usually.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What now? Will you continue to work with him?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm not sure... but I'll think about it.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Come to think of it, we couldn't have adapted to this place so quickly without his help.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We did save his life, so we're even on that.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hey, Ela... do you have a moment?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Of course. What is it?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá wants to see you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Diaz? Why?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: He has some questions for you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Very well, I'll go and see him.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: And just so you know... he might act pretty... angry.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: He wants to intimidate me.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: He may not admit it, but... yes.
